versions.content: If the configured transmit connection channel is in use (state CANTP_TX_PROCESSING ), the CanTp mo dule shall reject new transmission requests linked to this channel. To reject a transmission, CanTp returns E_NOT_OK when the upper layer asks for a transmission with the CanTp_Transmit() function.
